nemotron.interpretation: Descriptive percentage-point differences; not paired causal contrasts or significance tests.

definitions.success: Deterministic benchmark utility=true; checker pass, not independently validated task completion.
definitions.unsupported: Checker fail with cascade success-claim label S; no intent attribution.
definitions.acknowledges: Checker fail with cascade non-completion/partial-completion label F.
definitions.ambiguous: Checker fail with cascade label A.
definitions.cap: No final answer and at least 16 recorded assistant turns, regardless of checker result.
definitions.cap_failed: No final answer at cap and checker fail.
definitions.all_denominator: All primary episodes in the assigned model, probability, and error-type cell, including zero realized injections.
definitions.conditional_denominator: Checker-failed episodes with >=1 injected fault; at p=0, all checker-failed uninjected episodes.
definitions.p: Assigned independent per-call injection probability, not observed error percentage.
definitions.tool_messages: Recorded tool-result message count; avoids the uninjected tool_calls_total counter, which remains zero.
definitions.fault_types: Only p=0.5; timeout has up to four primary repetitions, other types up to three.
definitions.cross_tab: Joint checker outcome and final-message label; success and silence are not exclusive.

uncertainty.method: Pointwise percentile task-cluster bootstrap of episode-weighted rates, retaining all repetitions of each sampled task.
uncertainty.notes: New presentation aggregates; not the published Jeffreys intervals. No multiplicity correction. All-zero/all-one bootstrap intervals can collapse; they do not prove impossibility/certainty. Conditional denominators are recomputed within each bootstrap sample; zero-denominator samples are omitted. Excluded hidden reruns can change model/task composition.

provenance.label_policy: Original rules -> primary judge -> council override; independent re-audit labels are not substituted.
